name: Austria: check of forms and supplied documents

common.check: Trial title and EU trial number (if assigned) match the protocol and CTIS; where the German title is used it is identical to the German full title entered for Austria in CTIS.
Every field the assistant answers is answered; fields that belong to the site, investigator or insurer are left empty, not invented.

Language matches requirements.json language_rules (English administrative dossier for multinational trials); signature only where the Austrian rule for that document requires it (N1 signed before upload; K, L and M not signed at submission).
CTIS title follows the naming guide and requirements.json.

AT-K1.check: Uses the European Commission informed-consent and recruitment-procedure template v2.0, not the superseded version.

The yes/no answers for incapacitated adults, minors, impartial witness and emergency match the project's populations and study facts; each 'yes' section is completed, each 'no' section gives the not-applicable answer.

Member State fields carry the Austrian rules: German participant documents and certified translations, wet-ink or qualified electronic consent signature, signature and dating by the person conducting the consent interview, section 41 AMG data information and consent, no new study-purpose data collection after full withdrawal.

Incapacitated adults: separate legal-representative form, participant involvement according to capacity, section 39 AMG no-prior-refusal condition for population-benefit research, post-hoc form after temporary incapacity, section 39 AMG excluded groups.

Minors: representative consent with legal entitlement confirmed per case, separate age-appropriate documents from age 8, decision-capable minor's own consent (section 39 AMG), refusal respected, re-consent at adulthood.
Impartial witness only for a person who cannot write; reason, witness selection and impartiality described.
Emergency: every Article 35 condition, Austrian post-hoc form, sequence of representative and participant consent, section 41(3) AMG data rule.
Recruitment routes and first act of recruitment match the recruitment material (K2) and the protocol.

AT-M1.check: One CV per principal investigator and Austrian site; dated and not older than one year.
Shows the section 43 AMG qualification including authority to practise independently in Austria, and relevant clinical-trial and indication experience.
No signature in the CTIS copy; the signed and dated CV is archived in the TMF or ISF.

AT-M2-DOI.check: One declaration per principal investigator and Austrian site; dated and current; interests answered by the investigator; no signature at submission.

AT-M-GCP.check: Evidence of completed ICH GCP training for each principal investigator, uploaded under the title agreed in DECISIONS.md D7.

AT-N1.check: The national Austrian Trial Site Suitability Form is used for every Austrian centre; not the generic EU site-suitability form.
Signed before upload by the site-specific responsible person (medical director, deputy medical director or equivalent functionary, or the signatory named in the current institution-specific list).
Signature is wet ink, advanced electronic or qualified electronic; no pasted scanned signature.
Planned participant numbers per site are recorded and reconciled with the insured number (O1/O2).

AT-O1.check: Insurer-issued confirmation of no-fault personal injury insurance under section 40 AMG for this trial.
Cover spans the full planned trial duration.
Insured participant number is at least the higher of the sum planned across the Austrian site-suitability forms and the number entered for Austria in the CTIS Member State Concerned data.
Unredacted except information irrelevant to the insurance assessment, such as a clearly identified premium amount.

AT-O2.check: Insurance policy and terms and conditions are provided.
The package allows assessment of participant insurance, extended investigator liability insurance and extended investigator criminal legal-protection insurance.
Insurer, policy number, contact route and participant obligations match the completed Austrian insurance passage in every participant document.
Combination study with different sponsors and insurers: the evidence covers both insurers and both are named in the participant documents.

AT-P1.check: Covers participant compensation, investigator compensation, funding and other relevant financial arrangements; states clearly when no compensation is offered.
Reimbursement of reasonable expenses is not presented as an incentive to participate.
Amounts, methods and conditions are identical in every participant document.
All reimbursement methods available at Austrian sites are listed and the consent form offers a choice where a site has more than one.
External reimbursement provider identified with its data processing; where optional, another permitted reimbursement route remains without loss of participation.

AT-R1.check: Contains the confirmation that Austrian national data-protection rules will also be followed (in the Commission template or as an additional Part II confirmation).
Sponsor details match the CTIS application.

AT-S1.check: New and archive sample sections match the protocol and sample plan; at least one is completed.
Analysis, storage, duration, access, coding and transfers match the participant documents and R1.

Future use: research field delimited (not unlimited), retained samples, storage location and duration, responsible function for storage and destruction, destruction right for pseudonymised samples; consistent with the separate secondary-use information and consent.
